research.text: My research focuses on developing methods at the interface of inference and machine learning, oriented towards problems in sports analytics and natural language processing . My work has been featured in popular media outlets such as The Athletic, FiveThirtyEight, The Wall Street Journal, and The Washington Post. I am a three-time degree holder from Carnegie Mellon: with a bachelors, masters, and PhD in Statistics. I also have industry experience in both finance and professional sports.
